# Invictus AI (Detailed)

> Complete patient growth system for dental clinics in India, integrating conversion-focused websites, hyper-local Meta Ads, and automated Google reputation management.

## About Invictus AI

Invictus AI provides a closed-loop patient acquisition system exclusively for dental clinics. Unlike generic digital marketing agencies, Invictus AI focuses entirely on the dental industry in India, providing a fully integrated engine: a conversion-optimized website, hyper-local social media advertising, and automated Google review generation.

The core promise is predictable patient flow backed by a 60-day risk-free guarantee: if a clinic doesn't double its patient inquiries in 60 days (with a minimum ₹5,000/month ad budget), Invictus AI works for free until the target is met.

## Core Services

- [Clinic Website Service](https://invictus-ai.in/services/clinic-website): Custom, mobile-first websites designed for conversion. Features include direct WhatsApp booking integration, Google Maps embeds, and automated on-page SEO targeting local dental keywords. Pricing starts at ₹7,000.
- [Meta Ads & Content](https://invictus-ai.in/services/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram campaigns targeting a 5km radius around the clinic. This includes A/B tested ad creatives, retargeting campaigns, and monthly custom social media content. Pricing starts at ₹8,000/month.
- [Reputation Management](https://invictus-ai.in/services/reputation-management): Automated Google review generation software that texts patients post-visit for 5-star reviews, shielding clinics from negative feedback via internal routing. Pricing starts at ₹3,000/month.
- [AI Chatbot](https://invictus-ai.in/services/ai-chatbot): 24/7 automated WhatsApp/website chatbot to handle common patient inquiries and appointment scheduling.

## Free Tools

- [Website Audit](https://invictus-ai.in/tools/website-audit): A free tool offering a 360-degree review of a clinic's existing website, checking for mobile responsiveness, loading speed, and conversion friction points.

## Blog & Educational Content

- [Blog Homepage](https://invictus-ai.in/blog): Actionable growth strategies, marketing guides, and case studies for dentists. All content emphasizes the importance of avoiding unoptimized ad spend and focusing on holistic, systemized patient growth.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **How do I get more patients for my dental clinic?** The most effective way is installing a complete patient growth system — a high-converting website, targeted hyper-local Meta Ads (Instagram and Facebook), and automated Google review generation.
- **How much does dental clinic marketing cost in India?** Services start from ₹7,000 for a custom clinic website, ₹8,000/month for hyper-local Meta Ads, and ₹3,000/month for automated Google reputation management.
- **How long does it take to see results?** The system goes live in under 2 weeks. Most clinics see predictable inquiries in their first month.
